record.question: Which of the following option is not mentioned under section 53 of BSA, 2023 ? Facts admitted need not be proved in any proceeding:
options: Which the parties thereto or their agents agree to admit at the hearing
Which before the hearing they agree to admit by any writing under their hands
Which by any rule of pleading in force at the time they are deemed to have admitted by their pleadings
Which the parties admit only during cross -examination of witnesses and also proved by documentary evidence.
